events.event: DataReportal's Digital 2027 Indonesia report, cited by detikInet, shows Indonesian mobile connections fell about 38 million in two years to 311 million in October 2026, which Komdigi attributes to cleaning invalid data under biometric SIM registration.
events.key_numbers: 311 million connections Oct 2026 vs 349 million Oct 2024 (-10.9%) · -19 million (-5.8%) year on year · Komdigi: active subscribers 318 million (Q1 2025) to about 291 million (Q3 2026) · churn from above 20% to 2.8% · 311 million is about 108% of 288 million population
events.why_it_matters: Millions of phone numbers vanished after SIM registration, which affects anyone whose number was deactivated or recycled.

events.event: XLSmart reported Rp4.8 trillion (US$294 million) of cumulative merger synergy for January-September 2026 and raised its 2026 synergy target.
events.key_numbers: US$294 million (about Rp4.8 trillion) synergy, +80% vs US$166 million · target raised to above US$300 million · revenue Rp35.77 trillion (+17%) · normalized net profit Rp3.59 trillion (+94%) · 70 million customers Q3 · blended ARPU Rp47,500 vs Rp38,900 · 96% network integration
events.why_it_matters: Shows what the XL-Smartfren merger delivered, and ARPU up 22% hints at what mobile users pay.

events.event: Megaspeed said Alice Huang left the company effective 30 August 2025 and that it is running an internal probe, while Indonesia's police chief confirmed an FBI request over alleged Nvidia chip smuggling by PT Megaspeed International Indonesia, and Indosat spoke out on the case.
events.key_numbers: Megaspeed total assets up about 90x end-2023 to 2024, to nearly US$3 billion · Singapore probe since Feb 2025 · Bareskrim investigating, police say no search yet (conflicts with earlier report of an early 2026 search)
events.why_it_matters: An Indonesian data-centre player is tied to a US-China chip export scandal, with the national police now involved.

events.event: Jensen Huang said he is ready to return as Nvidia CEO if the board decides so, a day after Trump said he had no objection and Nvidia said Huang would not return.
events.key_numbers: 17 Nov: Nvidia says Huang will not return; Trump no objection · 18 Nov 09:30 WIB Huang statement (headline only)
events.why_it_matters: Leadership of the world's most valuable chip firm is unsettled, which moves AI and chip stocks.
